title: More Homes, Fewer Buyers: Why the Housing Market Remains Stuck
summary: The US housing market is offering buyers more choices, yet transaction activity remains stalled. Even though the inventory of existing homes for sale has been rising since late 2023, we have seen the annual sales trend flatline at around four million units.

title: Midterm Election Results: Winning on Inflation Is One Thing, Controlling Inflation Is Another
summary: The results of the midterm elections have generated plenty of headlines and speculation about what comes next for the US economy. While the political landscape has shifted, ITR Economics has not changed our economic forecasts as a result of the election.

title: Data Center Construction Is a Growing Segment of the US Economy
summary: Data center construction has become an increasingly important component of US private nonresidential construction, supported by rising demand for artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and digital infrastructure. As investment in these technologies expands, data center construction is experiencing growth that stands in sharp contrast to trends in the broader construction market.

title: The High-Tech Growth Cycle: Opportunities, Risks, and What’s Ahead
summary: The US industrial economy is growing, but the benefits are far from evenly distributed. While overall industrial production is increasing at a modest 1.3% annual rate, high-tech markets are expanding much faster. title: Manufacturing Isn't Moving in One Direction. Are You Watching the Right Markets?
summary: For manufacturers, understanding where the economy is headed is important. But what will drive better decisions is understanding where your specific markets are headed.

title: AI Is Lifting Business Investment — but How Broad Is the Boom?
summary: Investments tied to artificial intelligence and high technology are becoming an increasingly important force in US capital spending and industrial production. However, that growth is concentrated in a relatively narrow group of technology-related markets.

title: Commercial Real Estate in 2026: Signs of Recovery, Risks to Watch
summary: Today’s CRE market looks different from the downturns of the past — and the risks have changed with it.

title: The 2030s Action Plan: 7 Decisions That Can’t Wait Until 2030
summary: For years, ITR Economics has been helping business leaders understand why the 2030s are likely to bring a period of significant economic disruption. As the decade draws closer, however, understanding this outlook is no longer enough.

title: Is Consumer Spending Running Out of Fuel?
summary: Consumer spending remains one of the more dependable sources of US economic growth. Even as households face higher prices, elevated interest rates, and growing financial pressure, retail sales continue to expand.

summary:

title: How BAAJA could help geothermal gain ground
summary:
The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act introduced in the Senate last month isn’t just a landmark package for efficiently moving electricity where it needs to go. It’s also a way to help scale geothermal, a valuable but vastly underused energy resource, to get more electrons on the grid in the first place.
The post How BAAJA could help geothermal gain ground appeared first on Niskanen Center.

summary:

title: Linking housing affordability to successful transit: Lessons from Colorado’s Transit Oriented Communities law
summary:
Colorado’s TOC law is a potentially effective step toward broadly incentivizing transit-oriented development across the state. As written, the law could drive significant growth of housing supply near transit in the Denver region and place the RTD rail transit system on a strong financial footing through greatly increased ridership.

title: 'Inside Gaza' wins best documentary at Montreal's Cinemania film festival
summary:
"Inside Gaza," a documentary that follows journalists from global news agency AFP after the October 7, 2023 attack, received the Best Documentary Film award at Montreal's Cinemania Film Festival on Saturday.
Directed by Helene Lam Trong, the 72-minute film follows the daily lives of four AFP journalists who bear witness to the difficulties of reporting in a war-torn territory largely closed off to international media.
The film is compiled from material produced by the team on the ground, as well

title: McIlroy dedicates record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title to father
summary:
An emotional Rory McIlroy sealed a record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title on Sunday after a second-placed finish behind Tyrrell Hatton at the DP World Tour Championship edged out Eugenio Chacarra.
McIlroy dedicated the win to his father Gerry who had a double lung transplant at the end of September and has been in a Cleveland hospital since then.

title: Three men sentenced to death over Jordan church attack
summary:
A Jordanian court on Sunday sentenced three men to death by hanging over a deadly church shooting, as the kingdom's Christmas celebrations were cancelled in solidarity with the victims' families.
Gunmen killed nine people and wounded 25 others when they stormed a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in southern Hammoud village, Karak governorate, on October 23.

summary: AMMAN, Nov 15 (Reuters) - Jordan’s State Security Court sentenced three men to death on Sunday for carrying out an attack on a church in the southern governorate of Karak last month that killed nine people, the state news agency Petra reported.The court convicted the men of offences including carrying out terrorist acts resulting in death, possessing weapons and ammunition for terrorist purposes and promoting the ideology of a terrorist group. The ruling is subject to appeal and automatic review

summary: By Nidal al-Mughrabi and Yomna EhabNov 15 (Reuters) - Hamas said on Sunday that a senior commander who helped plan and oversee the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel had been killed in an Israeli airstrike, with the Israeli military confirming his death.Samir Abu Younis, 53, the commander of the Rafah brigade, was killed on Saturday, said the Palestinian militant group's armed wing, the Al-Qassam Brigades.

summary: By Mohammed GhobariNov 15 (Reuters) - Yemeni government forces announced on Sunday they were withdrawing from the area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to focus on a defence of their main base in Aden, in a major setback for the Saudi-backed campaign against the Iran-aligned Houthis. title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts missiles towards Riyadh, drones in Eastern Province
summary: Nov 15 (Reuters) - The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said on Sunday it had intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles launched towards the Saudi capital Riyadh and three drones in the kingdom's oil-rich Eastern Province.The Houthis, who control most of the populous parts of Yemen, have intensified attacks on the Saudi capital in recent days. A Houthi attack last week damaged an administrative building of the state oil company Saudi Aramco in Riyadh's financial hub.

title: Scattered by war, the band that gave voice to Sudan's revolution plays again
summary:
The Cairo studio where Sudanese musician Mohamed al-Mustafa strums his guitar is a long way away from the Khartoum protests where his band once performed for thousands demanding democracy, before war scattered them across multiple continents.
After living through revolution, war and years of displacement, Mustafa and his fellow musicians in "Aswat al-Madina" (Arabic for Voices of the City) have reunited in the Egyptian capital, returning to both recording and live performance.

summary:
Israel's caretaker prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Saturday reiterated his calls for a national unity government with his opponent Gadi Eisenkot, who in turn dismissed the appeal as a ruse.
The latest exchange comes as Eisenkot is in the midst of negotiations to form a government, after he was tapped for the post of premier on Sunday.
